definitions: Used to introduce a subordinate clause reporting speech or thought.
Used to introduce a subordinate clause giving the reason for something.
Used to introduce a subordinate clause expressing a result or consequence.
Used to introduce a subordinate clause expressing purpose.
Used after certain verbs and adjectives to introduce a subordinate clause.
Used to introduce a clause qualifying a noun or pronoun.
examples: She said that she was tired.
It was so cold that the water froze.
He works hard that he may succeed.
It is important that you listen.
The fact that he lied is clear.
